Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Enhanced keyword vectorization with TF-IDF, context & depth scoring

SCORING ALGORITHM IMPROVEMENTS:
- Added TF-IDF \(Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency\) weighting
- Implemented N-gram support \(unigrams, bigrams, trigrams\) for multi-word matching
- Added context-aware scoring based on surrounding keyword density
- Added depth scoring based on position in document \(title/intro weighted higher\)
- Improved cosine similarity calculation

VECTORIZATION FEATURES:
- Keywords loaded from Models_Masterdoc.csv with IDF pre-computation
- Augmented Term Frequency normalization to prevent document length bias
- Global IDF map cached for performance
- Position tracking for context/depth calculations

SCORING FORMULA:
Combined score = \(similarity * 0.25\) + \(TF-IDF * 0.25\) + \(context * 0.2\) + \(depth * 0.15\) + \(frequency * 0.15\)
Final score = baseScore * categoryPriority

DEPTH SCORING WEIGHTS:
- First 10% \(title/intro\): 1.0x
- Last 10% \(conclusion\): 0.85x
- Early content \(10-30%\): 0.75x
- Late content \(70-90%\): 0.65x
- Middle content: 0.5x

CONTEXT SCORING:
- Analyzes surrounding text window \(10 tokens default\)
- Boosts score when related category keywords found nearby
- Base score 0.5 + up to 0.5 bonus for related keywords

NEW FUNCTIONS:
- deepContextSearch\(\): Find keywords with surrounding context and related terms
- createNgrams\(\): Generate n-grams for phrase matching
- calculateContextScore\(\): Score based on keyword density in context window
- calculateDepthScore\(\): Score based on document position
- cosineSimilarity\(\): Vector similarity calculation

API UPDATES:
- findSimilarKeywords now accepts fullText parameter for context/depth scoring
- Both live and demo modes pass full text for proper analysis
EOF
\)")
